label: constraint x GTEx brain expression
detail: Inner join on unversioned ENSG. Losses are genes present in gnomAD v2.1.1 (GENCODE v19 era) with no counterpart in the GTEx v10 median-TPM matrix -- retired or merged IDs, mostly.

label: universe x SCHEMA statistics
detail: LEFT join: genes without SCHEMA statistics stay in the universe. They are still valid denominator entries -- a gene can lack an exome association and still have, or lack, a cis-eQTL.
